about: KPC holiday art (Brandon, Oct 26 2026). Website (chat 1): show the holiday's .webp on the home page from 'show_days' before the date through the day itself, then back to normal. Posts (chat 5): on the morning of the date, post the -post.jpg + 'post' text to Discord + the Facebook Page (+ website announcement), one post per holiday, no emails. Dates: 'MM-DD' fixed, or a rule. Edit the post text here; no code change needed. HOLD: nothing shows or posts until Brandon says GO. EFFECT (Brandon Oct 26: 'graphics like snow for Christmas'): light animated touch on the home page while the picture shows: snow / leaves / bats / hearts / clovers / fireworks / petals / sparks; 'none' on Memorial Day, Veterans Day (solemn), Labor Day, Father's Day. Off with reduced motion and when printing, tap to stop, low CPU, stops itself after ~30 s on phones.

holidays.name: Valentine's Day
holidays.post: Happy Valentine's Day from the Kentucky Portable Club! Take your sweetheart to a park and get on the air together. 73

holidays.name: St. Patrick's Day
holidays.post: Happy St. Patrick's Day from the Kentucky Portable Club! May your bands be open and your pileups lucky. 73

holidays.name: Easter
holidays.post: He is risen! Happy Easter from the Kentucky Portable Club. 73

holidays.name: Mother's Day
holidays.post: Happy Mother's Day from the Kentucky Portable Club to all the moms, and to every mom who puts up with antennas in the trees. 73

holidays.name: Memorial Day
holidays.post: This Memorial Day, the Kentucky Portable Club remembers the men and women who gave their lives in service to our country. All gave some, some gave all.

holidays.name: Father's Day
holidays.post: Happy Father's Day from the Kentucky Portable Club! Here's to the dads who taught us to tie knots, build things and get outside. 73

holidays.name: ARRL Field Day
holidays.post: It's Field Day weekend! Set up outside, get on the air, and have fun. Good luck to everyone operating. 73

holidays.name: Independence Day
holidays.post: Happy Independence Day from the Kentucky Portable Club! Enjoy the fireworks, and if you're out at a park today, good luck with the activation. 73

holidays.name: Labor Day
holidays.post: Happy Labor Day from the Kentucky Portable Club! Enjoy the long weekend, and maybe squeeze in one more park. 73

holidays.name: Halloween
holidays.post: Happy Halloween from the Kentucky Portable Club! If you're out at a park tonight, watch for things that go beep in the night. 73

holidays.name: Veterans Day
holidays.post: On Veterans Day, the Kentucky Portable Club honors and thanks everyone who has served. Honor. Remember. Thank.

holidays.name: Thanksgiving
holidays.post: Happy Thanksgiving from the Kentucky Portable Club! We're thankful for every contact, every park and every one of you. 73

holidays.name: Christmas
holidays.post: Merry Christmas from the Kentucky Portable Club! Wishing you and your family a blessed Christmas. 73
